# Ephinea Tools

> Unofficial web tools for the PSOBB Ephinea private server (Phantasy Star Online Blue Burst).
> A character stat & equipment-effect simulator, and an inventory/bank item browser with
> Price guide-based value estimates. All user data stays in the browser (localStorage);
> nothing is sent to a server. Japanese and English versions available.

## Pages

- [Home / data import (JA)](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/): import your AllItems_with_slot.txt character data
- [Stat simulator (JA)](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/simulator/): class/level/mag/material/gear stat calculation with equipment & set effect breakdown, stat caps, presets
- [Item list (JA)](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/inventory/): search all characters' inventories and banks, with PD value estimates
- [Wishlist (JA)](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/wishlist/): reverse drop-chart lookup (difficulty / Section ID / enemy / rate) and PD values for items you want
- English versions: [https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/en/](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/en/), [https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/en/simulator/](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/en/simulator/), [https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/en/inventory/](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/en/inventory/), [https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/en/wishlist/](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/en/wishlist/)

## Data sources

- Equipment, prices and technique mechanics: Ephinea PSO Wiki (https://wiki.pioneer2.net)
- Drop rates: Ephinea official drop charts (https://ephinea.pioneer2.net/drop-charts/)
- Character growth data: vanilla PSOBB
- Item values: Ephinea Price guide (https://wiki.pioneer2.net/w/Price_guide)
